units: <cite ref="Berakhot 9a:27">Ber. 9ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 12:11">Ex. XII, 11</cite>) <he>עד שעת ח׳</he> (which means, you may eat of the Passover lamb) up to the time of leaving in haste.

Ib. על שעת ח׳ וכ׳ (they differ) as to the time of ḥippazon; R. El. saying ח׳ דמצרים hipp. refers to the hastening of the Egyptians (ib. 30, sq., at night), while R. Ak. refers it to ח׳ דישראל the haste of the Israelites (in the morning, Num. XXXIII, 3); Mekh. Bo, s. 7 זה חֶפְזוֹן מצרים this (Ex. XII, 11) refers to &c.
<cite ref="Exodus 12:11">Ib.</cite> <he>ח׳ שכינה</he> the haste (anxiety) of the Deity.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 130:6">Sifré Deut. 130</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 16:3">Deut. XVI, 3</cite>) <he>יכול ח׳ לישראל ולמצרים</he> you might think, there was anxiety (fear) on the part of Israel and of Egypt.
<cite ref="Pesachim 96a:24">Ib. 96ᵃ</cite> <he>אותו נאכל בח׳ וכ׳</he> this was eaten in haste, but no other &c.—
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 19:6">Ex. R. s. 19</cite>; a. e.
